Hello, we are Toy Planet. 🪐

A small Indian toy shop for curious kids aged 3 and up. Every toy on our shelf has one job: to help a child learn something real, with their hands, away from a screen.

We are starting with handwriting, because it is the first skill most children practise every single day. Follow along for simple, honest ideas you can try at home.

#toyplanet #earlylearning #kidslearning #learningathome

Four promises behind every toy we sell.

1. Every toy has a job. If we cannot say what a child learns from it, it does not make the shelf.
2. Honest age guidance, not the widest range we can print.
3. No big claims. Skills grow with practice, slowly, and we will say so.
4. Screen-free by design. Paper, pens, hands and attention.

If we ever fall short of these, tell us.

#toyplanet #indianparents #playbasedlearning #parentingtips

Before letters, there are four strokes. ✏️

The standing line, the sleeping line, the open curve and the slanting line build almost every letter of the alphabet. Children who can draw them calmly usually find letters much easier.

Practise one stroke a day for a few minutes. Go big first (in the air, in a tray of sand), then on paper with guide lines. Correct the direction, not the neatness.

Save this post for practice time.

#handwritingpractice #preschoolactivities #finemotorskills #handwritingtips

The ink that leaves, so the page can stay.

In the Magic Practice Copybook, the pages have letters pressed in as grooves. The magic pen follows them, the ink fades away on its own, and the same page is ready again.

Four reusable books (Alphabet, Numbers, Math, Drawing), one magic pen, 10 refills and a pen grip, for ages 3 and up. Link in bio.

#handwritingpractice #kidslearning #toddleractivities #montessoriathome #toyplanet

Why tracing comes before free writing.

When a child follows a line, the hand learns where a letter starts and which way it turns. That stops backwards letters from becoming habits that are hard to unlearn later.

Once a letter feels easy to trace, try the same one on a blank line. That is the moment tracing has done its job.

#handwritingpractice #earlylearning #learningathome #indianparents

Left-handed? Tilt the page the other way. ✍️

With the page set straight, a left hand often hooks over its own writing and smudges it. Turn the top corner of the page to the right and the wrist can stay below the line, so the arm stays relaxed and the ink stays clean.

Right-handers do the opposite: top corner turned slightly to the left.

#handwritingtips #finemotorskills #kidslearning #parentingtips

Ten minutes, three parts, then stop.

Warm up the hand for two minutes with big circles and lines. Spend five minutes on one letter family (c, a, d, g share the same curve). Finish with three minutes of free drawing.

Stop while it is still fun. A short practice they look forward to beats a long one they dread.

#preschoolactivities #kidsactivitiesathome #playbasedlearning #toddleractivities

Pegs on the shoulders of a wet shirt dry into small dents right at the front.

Peg the shirt or kurta upside down by its hem instead, or dry it on a hanger.

The marks then land on the tail that gets tucked in, where nobody looks.

Try it this weekend.

#laundrytips #fabriccare #homecare #dailyuse

Near the sea, steel bathroom fittings show orange spots sooner: the air carries salt.

Salty, damp air from the coast settles on taps, towel rods and screws, so rust spots start faster than in an inland home.

Wipe the fittings dry and look at them every couple of weeks.

Save this post.

#bathroomcleaning #cleaninghacks #homecare #hardwaterstains

An hour of rangoli kneeling on a bare floor presses straight on both kneecaps.

Fold a thin cushion under the knees, move to a low stool for the border, and stand up and stretch every so often.

Stop if anything hurts.

How long does the rangoli take at your home? Tell us in the comments.

#jointcare #indianparents #wellnessathome #familycare

Look at a dining table against window light: the middle dulls before the edges.

That is where plates and thalis are slid across it every day.

Our Wood & Furniture Polish Spray has beeswax and is made for finished wood. Dust first, mist lightly one section at a time, then buff off along the grain with a dry cloth. A soft low sheen, and light scratches look less visible. Pack of 2.

Link in bio.

#furniturecare #woodpolish #diwalicleaning #shribazaar

Watch a child write at a grown-up's table: the elbow stays up in the air.

When the table top is near chin height, the forearm cannot rest and the hand works from the shoulder.

Raise the child, not the table: a firm cushion on the chair and a box under the feet.

Save this post.

#handwritingpractice #kidslearning #studyathome #madeforindia

Wet mehndi paste marks fabric, but dried paste lifts off cloth with a blunt edge.

For the wedding season: let the paste dry fully before going near fabric, roll sleeves above the elbow, and drape an old dupatta or towel over the lap.

If paste lands on cloth, let it dry and lift it off over a bin before any water, because water first spreads the colour. Then spot-treat what is left and wash as usual. Test on a hidden seam first.

Save this post for the mehndi night.

#stainremoval #fabriccare #weddingseason #laundrytips

Run a fingernail along the edge where your steel sink meets the kitchen slab.

If the nail catches a gap, water from every wash can get under the rim and soak into the slab and the cabinet below.

Dry the edge fully and seal it with a thin bead.

Try the check this weekend.

#homerepair #waterproofing #diyhome #homecare

Standing still tires the legs and lower back more than an easy walk does.

At the stove, at a puja or in a shop queue, the same muscles hold the same position the whole time. Shift your weight, and rest one foot on a low step, then switch.

In the evening, a little comfort helps. Our soothing massage gel for knees, lower back, neck and shoulders is cooling, fast-absorbing and dries without leaving skin sticky. Pack of 2 jars. For external use only.

Link in bio.

#jointcare #wellnessathome #familycare #shribazaar

The lemon that brightens a brass diya can leave pale, dull spots on a wooden shelf.

Lemon and tamarind are acidic, and acid dulls a wood finish.

Clean the brass on newspaper on the floor, let it dry, then put it back on the shelf.

How do you clean your brass before Diwali? Tell us in the comments.

#furniturecare #diwalicleaning #woodpolish #homecare

Splash water on a tile and on the grout beside it: only the grout turns darker.

Glazed tile lets water bead on top; porous grout soaks it in, and the minerals stay behind as it dries.

That is why grout lines yellow before the tiles beside them do.

Save this post for your next bathroom clean.

#bathroomcleaning #hardwaterstains #cleaninghacks #homecare

Shake kumkum off a cloth before it gets wet: water turns the powder into a wider mark.

Brush or shake the dry powder away over a bin first, then look at what is left.

Our All in One Fabric Stain Remover (Pack of 2) is a liquid spot treatment for before the wash: cover the mark, leave it a few minutes, wash as usual. No scrubbing.

It helps lift everyday marks. Test on a hidden seam first. Link in bio.

#stainremoval #fabriccare #diwalicleaning #shribazaar

Getting up from the floor is easier as five small moves than as one big push.

Turn to one side with both hands on the floor. Come onto hands and knees. Bring one foot forward, flat, with a hand on that knee or on steady furniture.

Then push up slowly through the front leg, back straight. Stop if anything hurts.

Save this post.

#jointcare #indianparents #wellnessathome #familycare

Look at the bottom of a wooden bathroom door frame: it is often darker than the rest.

Mopping water collects in the gap between the frame and the floor, and the wood drinks it from below, so the foot darkens and softens first.

Dry the gap fully, then seal it with a thin bead that stays flexible.

Try it this weekend.

#homerepair #waterproofing #diyhome #homecare

Wax polish leaves a smooth sheen, so never polish a stair tread or a step stool top.

Wherever feet go, including a wooden floor, leave the polish off: it can make the surface slippery underfoot.

Polish the sides, legs and rails your hands touch, then buff off with a dry cloth along the grain.

Which wooden piece gets polished first before Diwali at your home? Tell us in the comments.

#furniturecare #woodpolish #diwalicleaning #shribazaar

Write a line under a lamp on your writing-hand side and watch the hand's shadow cover it.

For a right-handed child the light should come from the left; for a left-handed child, from the right.

Then the line being written stays bright and the pencil tip stays in view. A small change to the study table for relaxed practice at home.

Save this post.

#handwritingpractice #kidslearning #studyathome #indianparents

Made for three kinds of ground.

BAGIYA has two tools, one for each half of the garden. Which one fits depends on the ground you look after.

a. You keep a kitchen garden or flower beds: the 5-teeth weeding rake head lifts weeds between the plants you keep. It is a head only; the handle is not included and it fits a standard wooden pole.
b. You keep a yard, path or wall base fully clear: weed killer granules go onto the soil there, never on beds or plants you keep. Use gloves; keep away from children, pets and plants you want.
c. You have both: the rake for the beds, the granules for the bare ground around them.

మూడు రకాల నేలల కోసం తయారైంది.

Which one are you: a, b or c? Tell us in the comments, in your own language. 🌱

#growandguard #bagiya #gardeningindia #andhrapradesh

Its seeds look just like mustard.

Prickly poppy (satyanashi in Hindi) is a winter weed of fields, plot edges and beds. Look for spiny lobed leaves, pale yellow cup flowers and a spiny pod full of small dark round seeds that look like sarson.

Pull it while it is young, with gloves, before the pods form. Keep its seeds well away from mustard you sow or store.

इसके बीज बिल्कुल सरसों जैसे दिखते हैं।

Have you seen it in your fields or beds this winter? Know someone sowing sarson this season? Send this to them.

Mark what you keep before you clear.

Clearing an overgrown corner? Do it the right way round.
1. Walk the corner first and spot what you are keeping: a young tree, a tulsi, a flowering shrub.
2. Mark each one with a stick and a strip of bright cloth, so nobody clears it by mistake.
3. Clear the rest. Pull the tall growth and carry it out. Where you want the ground fully clear, BAGIYA Weed Killer Granules go onto the soil, never near the marked plants. Use gloves; keep away from children, pets and plants you want.

சுத்தம் செய்வதற்கு முன், வைத்திருப்பதைக் குறியிடுங்கள்.

Save this post, and keep it for clearing day.

#களை #tamilnadu #weeds #growandguard

Missed strips grow back first.

Seen from above, a bed weeded pull by pull is a row of bands, each about as wide as the rake head (20 cm). Where two bands don't meet, a thin sliver of soil is left untouched, and that is where the next weeds show.

Start each pull about half a head over the last one, so the bands overlap.

छूटी हुई पट्टियों में खरपतवार सबसे पहले लौटते हैं।

Look at the bed you weeded last: can you see the strips? Tell us in the comments.

#gardeningtools #terracegarden #weeding #growandguard

Weeds hide the boundary stone.

The stones at the corners of a plot sit in ground nobody works. Grass and weeds grow up around them, and one season later the marker is gone from sight. Keep a ring of ground around each stone fully clear.

BAGIYA Weed Killer Granules go onto the soil at the base of the weeds: sprinkle, water lightly, leave it. It clears whatever it reaches, so never use it on lawns, beds or plants you are keeping. Use gloves; keep it away from children, pets and plants you want.

కలుపు మొక్కలు సరిహద్దు రాయిని దాచేస్తాయి.

The details are on the link in our bio.

#కలుపు #telangana #andhrapradesh #weedcontrol #bagiya

Weeds grow right under the rose thorns.

Under a rose bush is the one patch hands avoid, so grass and weeds settle in below the thorns and stay there.

The BAGIYA 5-Teeth Weeding Rake Head has five pointed carbon-steel teeth, 20 cm wide. Stand outside the thorns, reach in under the bush and work with short pulls toward you: the weeds come out and the soil is loosened in the same stroke. Handle not included; it fits a standard wooden pole.

गुलाब के काँटों के ठीक नीचे खरपतवार उगते हैं।

Is there a rose bush in your garden? Tell us what grows under it. 🌱

#gardeningtools #बागवानी #kitchengarden #weeding #growandguard

This vine can bury a fence.

Mikania (Mikania micrantha), known in Malayalam as ധൃതരാഷ്ട്രപ്പച്ച and in English as Mikania vine, climbs fast over fences, vacant plots and roadsides in Kerala. Look for heart-shaped leaves in pairs along a thin twining stem, and small white flower clusters. It spreads over whatever it reaches, and broken stem pieces can root again.

Pull it off the fence and lift the stems out, before it flowers, so the broken bits do not stay on the soil.

ഈ വള്ളി ഒരു വേലി മുഴുവൻ മൂടും.

Is it on your fence? Tell us your district.

#കള #kerala #weeds #bagiya

Watch your shower head with the water on: holes that spray sideways are partly blocked.

White hard-water scale builds around each hole until the jet bends away from the rest.

Unscrew the head, or tie a bag of vinegar water around it overnight, then brush the face with an old toothbrush and rinse.

Try it this weekend.

#bathroomcleaning #hardwaterstains #cleaninghacks #homecare

A full bucket held at arm's length loads the lower back far more than one held close.

Diwali cleaning means buckets up and down the house.

Keep the bucket against your leg, bend the knees to lift it, and carry two half buckets, one in each hand, instead of one full one.

Stop if anything hurts.

Save this post.

Put a fingertip after each word: the gap it leaves is the space before the next one.

Young writers often run words together because the hand moves on before the eye checks.

A finger space makes the gap a habit; later, the eye takes over.

Does your child use finger spaces yet? Tell us in the comments.

#handwritingpractice #kidslearning #studyathome

Pour a mug of water where your balcony floor meets the wall: if it vanishes, so does rain.

That floor-to-wall joint takes rain splash every day and often opens first. Water that gets in shows up later as damp on the wall inside or on the ceiling below.

Our Transparent Waterproof Glue with Brush is a thick paste that dries clear, stays flexible and is waterproof once cured. Dry the joint fully, brush a thin coat along it, and give it a full day before water. Brush in the box, Pack of 2.

For small leaks and gaps. Not for drinking-water tanks or pipes.

Link in bio.

#homerepair #waterproofing #diyhome #shribazaar

Check every pocket before the wash: one ballpoint pen can dot ink across the whole load.

A pen that opens in the drum leaks a little on every turn.

Empty pockets as clothes go into the basket, not at the machine. If ink does land on a shirt, treat that spot before the next wash: hot sun or ironing can set it.

What turns up most often in your family's pockets? Tell us in the comments.

#laundrytips #fabriccare #stainremoval #homecare

Turn a bathroom cleaner around: the back label says which surfaces it must never touch.

Four lines are worth reading before the cap comes off: which surfaces it is for (many tile cleaners are not for marble, granite or natural stone), whether it is ready to use or to be diluted, gloves and an open window, and never mixing two cleaners.

Rinse the surface well with water before switching products.

Save this post for your pre-Diwali bathroom clean.

#bathroomcleaning #cleaninghacks #diwalicleaning #homecare

A hot cup set straight on a polished table leaves a pale ring in the finish.

Heat and steam push moisture into the wax and varnish, and the ring shows cloudy white.

Keep a coaster or a folded cotton napkin under every hot cup, steel tumbler and serving dish, especially with Diwali guests at the table.

Coaster or folded napkin at your table? Tell us in the comments.

#furniturecare #woodpolish #diwalicleaning #shribazaar

Ten quiet minutes a day beats one long session at the end of the holidays.

Short, regular practice is easier on a small hand, and the same table at the same time each day turns it into a habit.

Our Magic Practice Copybook has grooved guided pages to trace, ink that fades on its own so a page can be practised again, refills in the box and a pen with a finger grip. A practice aid.

Link in bio.

#handwritingpractice #kidslearning #studyathome #indianparents

Tap your floor tiles with a knuckle: a hollow sound means water can travel under it.

A tile that has lost its bed sounds dull and hollow, and water through a gap at its edge spreads below.

Mark the hollow ones in pencil, keep their joints sealed, and show a mason any large patch.

Try the tap test this weekend.

#homerepair #waterproofing #diyhome #homecare

On the stairs, step up with your stronger leg first and down with the other leg first.

Going up, the leading leg does the lifting; going down, it takes the landing.

Hold the rail and take one step at a time when carrying decorations to the terrace. Stop if anything hurts.

Save this post for the festive week.

#jointcare #familycare #wellnessathome #madeforindia

The yellow line inside a toilet bowl sits exactly at the water level.

Hard water dries a thin mineral ring right where the still water meets the glaze, and it builds a little more each day.

Our Bathroom & Tile Stain Remover Spray (Pack of 2) is ready to use for hard-water yellowing and rust marks on glazed tiles, sanitaryware and steel: spray, wait a few minutes, scrub lightly with a plastic brush, rinse with plenty of water.

Wear gloves, rinse well and never mix it with other cleaners. Not for marble, granite or natural stone. Link in bio.

#bathroomcleaning #hardwaterstains #homecare #shribazaar

Five small symbols on every clothes label: a tub, a triangle, an iron, a square, a circle.

The tub is washing, the triangle is bleach, the iron is heat, the square is drying and the circle is dry clean. Dots mean warmer or hotter; a cross means don't.

Read the label before you treat a stain, and test on a hidden seam first.

Save this post.

#laundrytips #fabriccare #stainremoval #weddingseason

Break a crayon in half: a short piece can only be held with the fingertips.

A long crayon gets gripped in a fist. A short stub makes small fingers pinch, the same thumb-and-two-fingers hold a pencil needs later.

A small practice idea for little hands, at their own pace.

Which colour runs out first in your child's crayon box? Tell us in the comments.

#handwritingpractice #kidslearning #studyathome #indianparents

Candle wax on a wooden table lifts cleanly once hard, with a plastic card, never a knife.

Soft wax smears into the grain, and a knife scratches the finish. Wait till it sets; an ice cube in a cloth speeds it up.

Ease it off with an old plastic card, then wipe and buff the spot with a dry cloth along the grain.

Try it this weekend.

#furniturecare #woodpolish #diwalicleaning #homecare

Photograph a damp patch while it is still wet: once dry, nobody can say where it began.

After the last rains, trace the patch edge in pencil and take a dated photo. A patch that grows from one corner points to the leak above it.

Seal small cracks above it before the next rains.

Save this post.

#homerepair #waterproofing #monsoonprep #diyhome

Pull along the row, never across it.

In a bed sown in rows (palak, methi, mooli, gajar), pulling the head across a row drags the teeth through the plants you are keeping. Pull along the gap between two rows instead and every stroke stays in open soil.

Stand on the path at the end of the bed and work one gap at a time, pulling toward you.

क्यारी की लाइन के साथ खींचें, आर-पार नहीं।

Are your beds sown in rows or broadcast? Tell us in the comments. 🌱

#weeding #kitchengarden #बागवानी #bagiya

Every concrete edge grows a line of weeds.

Rain runs off a slab, a step or a driveway and soaks the strip of soil right beside it. That strip stays wetter than the ground around it, so the weeds line up along every edge.

கான்கிரீட் ஓரத்தில் களைகள் வரிசையாக வளரும்.

Walk round your house today: which edge has the thickest line? Step, slab or driveway?

#களை #tamilnadu #weeds #growandguard

One winter bed, four times to weed.

A bed of palak, methi, mooli or gajar changes through the season, and so does the right way to weed it.
1. Before sowing: clear and loosen the whole bed.
2. When the seedlings show: weed only between the rows, and leave a hand's width around each seedling.
3. When the leaves spread: shallow skims only; the roots are near the surface.
4. After the last picking: clear the bed before the weeds set seed.

एक क्यारी, इस सर्दी निराई के चार मौके।

Save this post and keep it for the season.

#terracegarden #gardeningindia #बागवानी #growandguard

The wind plants your neighbour's weeds.

An empty plot next door goes to seed, and the wind carries those seeds over your wall. They settle where the wind drops: 1. against the wall that faces the plot, 2. behind the gate, 3. in the inside corner.

Those are the strips to keep fully clear. Where you want the ground completely clear, BAGIYA Weed Killer Granules go onto the soil there, never on lawns, beds or plants you are keeping. Use gloves; keep away from children, pets and plants you want.

పక్క ఖాళీ స్థలం నుంచి కలుపు విత్తనాలు గాలితో వస్తాయి.

Where do the weeds come up first in your yard: 1, 2 or 3? Tell us in the comments.

#కలుపు #andhrapradesh #telangana #bagiya

Chilli and brinjal beds need weeding till the last picking.

Leafy greens are in and out of the bed in weeks. Chilli and brinjal stay for months, and every watering brings a new flush of weeds between the plants, right through the picking season.

The BAGIYA 5-Teeth Weeding Rake Head has five pointed carbon-steel teeth, 20 cm wide. Stand on the path, reach between the plants and work with short pulls toward you: the weeds lift out and the soil is loosened in the same stroke. Handle not included; it fits a standard wooden pole.

मिर्च और बैंगन की क्यारी में आख़िरी तुड़ाई तक निराई चाहिए।

Have a look at the rake head on the link in our bio. 🌱

#kitchengarden #weeding #बागवानी #gardeningindia #bagiya

Wind piles seeds into the corners.

In a walled yard the wind swirls and drops whatever it carries in the inside corners: dry leaves, dust and seeds. That is why the corners are where the weeds start every season. Keep the corners of ground you want fully clear.

BAGIYA Weed Killer Granules go onto the soil at the base of the weeds: sprinkle, water lightly, leave it. It clears whatever it reaches, so never use it on lawns, beds or plants you are keeping. Use gloves; keep it away from children, pets and plants you want.

കാറ്റ് വിത്തുകളെ മൂലകളിലേക്ക് കൂട്ടുന്നു.

Send this to someone who sweeps the yard every morning.

#കള #kerala #weeds #growandguard

Roll the stem: three sides means it is not grass.

Nutgrass, or nutsedge (Cyperus rotundus), is called मोथा (motha) in Hindi, also नागरमोथा; கோரை in Tamil, తుంగ in Telugu and മുത്തങ്ങ in Malayalam. It looks like grass, but roll the stem between finger and thumb and you feel the edges: it is solid and three-sided. Under the soil it grows from small brown nut-like tubers, so snapping off the leaves leaves the tuber behind to sprout again.

Loosen the soil and lift the whole plant with its tubers, and keep the tubers out of the compost.

तना घुमाकर देखें: तीन कोने हों तो यह घास नहीं।

Is it in your beds? Tell us which vegetable it grows between.

#gardeningtools #terracegarden #बागवानी #growandguard

Writing goes best at a table, with both feet on the floor.

On a bed or the floor, the arm has nothing to rest on and the child hunches over the page. At a table, the forearm rests and the hand can do the work.

The set-up is simple: a steady table, a chair the right height, a box under the feet if they dangle, and light from the side.

Share this with a parent who is doing this too.

#learningathome #handwritingtips #finemotorskills #indianparents

Twenty-six capital letters, four families. ✏️

Straight lines (L, T, I, E, F, H), slanting lines (A, V, W, X, Y, Z, K, M, N), curves (C, O, Q, G, S), and lines with curves (B, D, P, R, J, U).

Teach one family at a time and start with the straight lines. Each slide shows where every stroke begins.

Save this post for your next practice time.

#handwritingpractice #preschoolactivities #earlylearning #kidsactivitiesathome

What to say during practice, and one thing to skip.

"Show me where this letter starts." "Which one do you like best on this line?" "Let's do one more, then stop." Short, specific words keep the focus on the letter, not on getting it perfect.

The one to skip: "That's wrong, do it again." Point to where the stroke left the path and try only that part together.

Which line do you already use at home? Tell us in the comments.

#parentingtips #playbasedlearning #kidslearning #montessoriathome

The grooves guide the pen; the grip guides the fingers.

In the Magic Practice Copybook, letters are pressed into the page so the pen tip stays on the path, and a soft pen grip shows little fingers where to sit. The magic ink fades on its own, so the same page is ready again.

In the box: 4 books, 1 magic pen, 10 refills and 1 pen grip. For ages 3 to 12.

Link in bio 🪐

#toyplanet #handwritingpractice #finemotorskills #earlylearning

Every small letter lives on one of three floors.

On four-line practice paper, most small letters stay in the middle floor: a, c, e, m, n, o. Tall letters climb to the top floor: b, d, h, k, l, t. Tail letters go down to the basement: g, j, p, q, y.

Which floor does your child's writing forget most? Tell us in the comments.

#handwritingtips #learningathome #kidslearning #parentingtips

Shine a phone torch low across a wooden table: every smear and dust line shows up.

Light skimming the surface catches what overhead light hides.

Run the test before guests arrive: wipe the dust first, then polish only the dull patches the torch reveals.

Try it this weekend.

#furniturecare #woodpolish #diwalicleaning #homecare

A short jhadu keeps your back bent for the whole floor; a long handle lets you stand.

Diwali cleaning means sweeping every room.

Use a long-handled broom for the big floors, switch hands now and then, and sit on a low stool for the corners.

Stop if anything hurts.

Save this post.

#familycare #indianparents #wellnessathome #dailyuse

Pages near a notebook's spine curve up, and letters written there slope with them.

Open the notebook flat, fold a soft-cover one back on itself, or write on the outer half of the page.

That way the line under the pencil stays level.

Which side of the page does your child start on? Tell us in the comments.

#handwritingpractice #kidslearning #studyathome

Keep the stain remover beside the laundry basket, not under the sink.

A mark treated on the day, while it sits on the surface, is easier to lift than one that has been through a hot iron or a week in the basket. Diwali week brings sweets, diya oil and chai marks.

Look below both ends of each window sill: rain dripping there cracks the plaster first.

Water runs off the sill and drops at its two ends every rain, so the plaster there opens before anywhere else, and the damp shows indoors below the window.

Check both ends on a dry day, and seal small hairline cracks once they are fully dry.

Rub a fingertip on a polished table: if it feels tacky, the wax was never buffed off.

Polishing finished wood takes five small steps, and the first two are the ones most often skipped.

Dust first with a dry soft cloth. Test on a hidden spot. Mist lightly, one section at a time (near glass or brass, spray the cloth instead). Buff along the grain with a second dry cloth. Then let it set for a while before use.

Gravel does not stop weeds.

Stone chips laid on bare soil keep the soil underneath cool and damp: the sun dries only the top of the stones. Seeds blown into the gaps root straight through into that soil, so a gravel yard or parking strip slowly goes green from below.

Pulling the tops leaves the roots behind in the damp soil under the stones.

Step back with each pull. Don't lean in.

Work from the path and let your feet do the travelling.

Three weeds that come back after every rain, named in four languages.

1. Bermuda grass (அருகம்புல் / గరిక / കറുക / दूब): fine blades on runners that root at every joint. Look along path and lawn edges first.
2. Creeping wood sorrel (புளியாரை / పులిచింత / പുളിയാറില / तिनपतिया): three heart-shaped leaflets, tiny yellow flowers, pods that burst and throw seed. Look in damp shade by walls and pots.
3. Coat buttons (வெட்டுக்காயப் பூண்டு / గడ్డి చామంతి / घमरा): toothed leaves in pairs and one small flower on a long bare stalk. Look on open, sunny ground.

Candle wax, ghee, diya soot and chai each need a different first step.

Wax: let it harden and lift it with a blunt edge, never iron over it. Ghee or oil: blot with a dry tissue, don't rub. Soot or ash: shake it off and lift it dry before any water. Chai: rinse from the back with cool water.

Then a spot treatment before the wash helps lift what is left. Test on a hidden seam first.
